senses.gloss: f. pl. (מָכַר) sales, trnsf. m. (cmp. לְקוּחוֹת) seller.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:5">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 49:6">Gen. XLIX, 6</cite> <he>מְכֵרֹת־</he>) for whom are those weapons fit? <he>למְכֵרוֹתֵיהֶן וכ׳</he> to their seller, to Esau who sold the birth-right (to their father).

senses.gloss: (= מְכֹרוֹת, fr. נָכַר, cmp. מַכָּר) friendship, neighborhood, neighbors. Tanḥ. Vayḥi 9; Gen. R. s. 99 (ref. to Gen. l. c.) וי״א מכרותיהם מגורותיהם וכ׳ (ed. Wil. מְכוֹר׳) and some say m’kherothehem, means their neighborhoods (ed. Wil.: and some say, read it m’khorothehen) as we read (Ez. XVI, 3) &c.—V. מְכֵירִין
